comparison.objective: Store five cartons in stacks obeying a height-to-base stability rule.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation-aware stacking, load distribution, and midline handoff.
comparison.success_condition: All cartons are seated in pad stacks, with no stack taller than three times its bottom carton's shorter base side.
comparison.reason: Tests spatial reasoning and stable stacking rather than dexterous fastener/collar manipulation.
